Issue a one-time code for the Chrome extension sign-in handoff.

The signed-in web app calls this, then redirects to `redirect_uri` with the code; the
extension redeems it at `POST /auth/extension-token`. Codes expire after 60 seconds.
Redeem a one-time extension code (single use, bound to its redirect URI) for tokens.

get.description: Browse or search the show catalog.
Show detail including seasons and episodes.

post.description:
Resolve what is playing on a streaming site to a catalog episode.

Lookup order: a previous match for `(provider, external_id)`; then the show by
case-insensitive exact title plus season/episode numbers. Anything still missing
(show, season, episode) is created on first sight, so every supported player works
before metadata enrichment. Always returns 200 with the matched episode.

get.description:
The episode after this one: next in the season, else the first of the next season.

404 if the episode doesn't exist or is the last one of its show.

put.description: Record playback progress. Reaching 90% marks the episode completed and feeds the streak.

get.description: Unfinished episodes for a profile, most recently watched first.

post.description:
Start a watch party for a video. The caller hosts it and is its first member.

Share `invite_url`; friends open it, sign in and call `POST /parties/{code}/join`.
Parties expire after `APP_PARTY_TTL_HOURS` (default 12).

get.description:
Look up a party by invite code (any signed-in user who has the code).

404 if the code is unknown or the party has ended or expired.

post.description:
Join a party (idempotent). Required before opening the party WebSocket.

404 if unknown, ended or expired; 409 when the party is full.

post.description:
